intro_1.text: Welcome in, everybody! We've got a great one on tap tonight, so settle in.
intro_1.speaker: pbp

intro_2.text: Good evening, and welcome to a packed house! Both teams look ready to go.
intro_2.speaker: pbp

intro_3.text: Hello again, everyone! The lights are bright, the crowd is loud, and we are just about ready for tip-off.
intro_3.speaker: pbp

intro_4.text: What an atmosphere tonight! Welcome to the show, folks.
intro_4.speaker: pbp

intro_5.text: Welcome back to another night of hoops! This matchup has been circled on the calendar for weeks.
intro_5.speaker: pbp

pa_welcome_1.text: Ladies and gentlemen... welcome... to the arena!
pa_welcome_1.speaker: pa

pa_welcome_2.text: Ladies and gentlemen... it's... GAME TIME!
pa_welcome_2.speaker: pa

pa_welcome_3.text: Good evening, basketball fans! Are... you... READY?
pa_welcome_3.speaker: pa

pa_welcome_4.text: Let's hear it... for tonight's matchup!
pa_welcome_4.speaker: pa

pa_starting_2.text: Ladies and gentlemen... please welcome... tonight's starters!
pa_starting_2.speaker: pa

pa_starting_4.text: Put your hands together... for the starting five!
pa_starting_4.speaker: pa

tipoff_1.text: Here's the jump... and we are underway!
tipoff_1.speaker: pbp

tipoff_2.text: The ball goes up, and we're off!
tipoff_2.speaker: pbp

tipoff_4.text: Up it goes... and they control the tip!
tipoff_4.speaker: pbp

tipoff_5.text: And here we go! The ball is in the air.
tipoff_5.speaker: pbp

made3_3.text: He lets it fly... bang! Three points!
made3_3.speaker: pbp

made3_4.text: Wide open from the corner... and he knocks it down!
made3_4.speaker: pbp

made3_5.text: That's a triple! Nothing but net!
made3_5.speaker: pbp

made3_6.text: He rises from beyond the arc... money!
made3_6.speaker: pbp

deep3_1.text: From way, way downtown... are you kidding me?!
deep3_1.speaker: pbp

deep3_2.text: He pulls up from the logo... and it is GOOD!
deep3_2.speaker: pbp

deep3_3.text: That is a long, long way out... and it drops! Unbelievable range!
deep3_3.speaker: pbp

deep3_4.text: Pull-up from thirty feet... splash! He's got the green light tonight!
deep3_4.speaker: pbp

deep3_5.text: Deep, deep three... got it! What a shot!
deep3_5.speaker: pbp

dunk_1.text: He rises... and throws it DOWN!
dunk_1.speaker: pbp

dunk_3.text: Into the lane... and he hammers it home!
dunk_3.speaker: pbp

dunk_4.text: Two hands... jam! The crowd loves it!
dunk_4.speaker: pbp

dunk_6.text: Off the bounce... and he flushes it!
dunk_6.speaker: pbp

poster_1.text: OH! He just put him on a poster!
poster_1.speaker: pbp

poster_2.text: Right on top of the defender! That one's going on the wall!
poster_2.speaker: pbp

poster_3.text: He dunked it right in his face! Somebody check on the defender!
poster_3.speaker: pbp

poster_5.text: He went up through the contact... and threw it DOWN! Wow!
poster_5.speaker: pbp

alleyoop_1.text: Lob is up... and it's slammed home! Alley-oop!
alleyoop_1.speaker: pbp

alleyoop_3.text: Throws it up to the rim... and he finishes the oop!
alleyoop_3.speaker: pbp

alleyoop_4.text: Look at that lob! Perfect timing!
alleyoop_4.speaker: pbp

alleyoop_5.text: Up top... and in! That's a highlight right there!
alleyoop_5.speaker: pbp

andone_1.text: And one! He scores through the contact!
andone_1.speaker: pbp

andone_2.text: Bucket, AND the foul! Count it!
andone_2.speaker: pbp

andone_3.text: He gets hit... and it still goes in! And one!
andone_3.speaker: pbp

andone_4.text: Strong to the rim... plus the foul!
andone_4.speaker: pbp

andone_5.text: Count it, and he's going to the line for one more!
andone_5.speaker: pbp

block_4.text: Swatted away! What a defensive play!
block_4.speaker: pbp

block_5.text: He met him at the summit... BLOCKED!
block_5.speaker: pbp

steal_3.text: He jumps the passing lane... and takes it away!
steal_3.speaker: pbp

steal_5.text: Steal! And they're going the other way!
steal_5.speaker: pbp

fastbreak_1.text: Out in transition... they're off to the races!
fastbreak_1.speaker: pbp

fastbreak_5.text: Push it ahead... nobody back on defense!
fastbreak_5.speaker: pbp

ankles_1.text: OH! He sent him to the floor! Ankles broken!
ankles_1.speaker: pbp

ankles_2.text: Crossover... and the defender goes down!
ankles_2.speaker: pbp

ankles_3.text: Stop-and-go... and the defender just fell over!
ankles_3.speaker: pbp

ankles_4.text: Somebody get that man a new pair of ankles!
ankles_4.speaker: pbp

ankles_5.text: Shook him right out of his shoes!
ankles_5.speaker: pbp

miss_5.text: Clanks off the back of the rim.
miss_5.speaker: pbp

miss_7.text: Short. The rebound is up for grabs.
miss_7.speaker: pbp

airball_1.text: Airball! [chuckle] He'll want that one back.
airball_1.speaker: pbp

airball_3.text: Air ball! The crowd is letting him hear it!
airball_3.speaker: pbp

airball_4.text: That one didn't even draw iron.
airball_4.speaker: pbp

shotclock_1.text: Shot clock violation! Great defense forced that one.
shotclock_1.speaker: pbp

shotclock_2.text: They couldn't get a shot off in time. Shot clock violation!
shotclock_2.speaker: pbp

shotclock_3.text: And the shot clock expires! Turnover!
shotclock_3.speaker: pbp

shotclock_4.text: Time ran out on that possession. Shot clock violation.
shotclock_4.speaker: pbp

turnover_3.text: Bad pass, and that's a turnover.
turnover_3.speaker: pbp

turnover_4.text: Coughed it up. That's one they'd like back.
turnover_4.speaker: pbp

foul_4.text: They call the foul on that one.
foul_4.speaker: pbp

freethrows_1.text: He'll head to the line for two.
freethrows_1.speaker: pbp

freethrows_2.text: Going to the free throw line.
freethrows_2.speaker: pbp

timeout_2.text: And they call timeout to regroup.
timeout_2.speaker: pbp

timeout_3.text: We'll take a timeout here. Plenty to talk about.
timeout_3.speaker: pbp

timeout_4.text: The coach has seen enough. Timeout.
timeout_4.speaker: pbp

endq1_1.text: And that'll do it for the first quarter!
endq1_1.speaker: pbp

endq1_3.text: First quarter is in the books!
endq1_3.speaker: pbp

endq2_1.text: That's the end of the second quarter!
endq2_1.speaker: pbp

endq2_2.text: And the horn sounds to end the first half!
endq2_2.speaker: pbp

endq2_3.text: Two quarters down, two to go!
endq2_3.speaker: pbp

endq3_1.text: End of three! Twelve minutes to decide it!
endq3_1.speaker: pbp

endq3_2.text: Third quarter is in the books, and it all comes down to the fourth!
endq3_2.speaker: pbp

endq3_3.text: That'll wrap up the third quarter!
endq3_3.speaker: pbp

halftime_1.text: That's halftime! Let's take a breath and reset.
halftime_1.speaker: pbp

halftime_2.text: We've reached the break! Plenty of basketball still to play.
halftime_2.speaker: pbp

halftime_3.text: Halftime here. What a first half that was!
halftime_3.speaker: pbp

halftime_4.text: Into the locker rooms they go. See you in the second half!
halftime_4.speaker: pbp

buzzer_1.text: At the buzzer... GOT IT! Are you kidding me?!
buzzer_1.speaker: pbp

buzzer_3.text: Time winding down... he fires... BANG! At the buzzer!
buzzer_3.speaker: pbp

buzzer_4.text: With no time left... it's GOOD! Pandemonium!
buzzer_4.speaker: pbp

closelate_1.text: This one is going down to the wire!
closelate_1.speaker: pbp

closelate_2.text: Every possession counts now. Nobody can breathe in here.
closelate_2.speaker: pbp

closelate_3.text: Tight ballgame, late in the fourth. This is what it's all about!
closelate_3.speaker: pbp

closelate_4.text: Neck and neck in the closing minutes!
closelate_4.speaker: pbp

closelate_5.text: Crunch time, folks! Who wants it more?
closelate_5.speaker: pbp

blowout_1.text: This one's getting out of hand.
blowout_1.speaker: pbp

blowout_3.text: A total runaway tonight. Complete domination.
blowout_3.speaker: pbp

blowout_4.text: The lead keeps growing. This could be a long night for the other side.
blowout_4.speaker: pbp

overtime_2.text: Regulation can't separate them! Bonus basketball!
overtime_2.speaker: pbp

overtime_3.text: Free basketball, everybody! Five more minutes!
overtime_3.speaker: pbp

overtime_4.text: Tied at the end of regulation... we need overtime!
overtime_4.speaker: pbp

finalwin_1.text: That's the ballgame! What a win!
finalwin_1.speaker: pbp

finalwin_2.text: Final horn! They get the victory, and the crowd is going wild!
finalwin_2.speaker: pbp

finalloss_1.text: That's the final. A tough one tonight.
finalloss_1.speaker: pbp

finalloss_2.text: The horn sounds, and that one slips away.
finalloss_2.speaker: pbp

finalloss_3.text: Final score is in. They'll have to regroup for next time.
finalloss_3.speaker: pbp

finalloss_4.text: Ballgame. Not their night, but they fought hard.
finalloss_4.speaker: pbp

onfire_3.text: He's heating up! Somebody stop him!
onfire_3.speaker: pbp

onfire_4.text: Another one! He is in the zone!
onfire_4.speaker: pbp

onfire_5.text: Feeling it tonight! The basket looks as big as an ocean right now!
onfire_5.speaker: pbp

run_1.text: That's a big run! The momentum has completely flipped!
run_1.speaker: pbp

run_3.text: What a stretch! They're taking over this game!
run_3.speaker: pbp
